charge_applications_one_source.name: charge_applications_one_source
charge_applications_one_source.value: (payment_id is not null and credit_id is null) or (payment_id is null and credit_id is not null)

charge_applications_reversal_shape.name: charge_applications_reversal_shape
charge_applications_reversal_shape.value: (reverses_id is null and amount_paise > 0) or (reverses_id is not null and amount_paise < 0)

charges_origin_shape.name: charges_origin_shape
charges_origin_shape.value:
(origin = 'participation'::charge_origin and participation_id is not null and policy_kind is null)
          or (origin = 'policy'::charge_origin and participation_id is not null and policy_kind is not null)
          or (origin = 'manual'::charge_origin and policy_kind is null)

charges_state_reason.name: charges_state_reason
charges_state_reason.value:
(state = 'locked'::charge_state and state_reason is null and state_at is null)
          or (state <> 'locked'::charge_state and state_reason is not null and state_at is not null)

collection_attempts_key_uq.name: collection_attempts_key_uq
collection_attempts_key_uq.where: provider is not null and idempotency_key is not null

court_holds_holder.name: court_holds_holder
court_holds_holder.value: (kind = 'tournament' and tournament_id is not null and session_id is null) or (kind = 'session' and session_id is not null and tournament_id is null) or (kind = 'block' and tournament_id is null and session_id is null)

court_holds_block_reason.name: court_holds_block_reason
court_holds_block_reason.value: kind <> 'block' or (reason is not null and btrim(reason) <> '')

game_sessions_gate_order.name: game_sessions_gate_order
game_sessions_gate_order.value: confirm_opens_at is null or confirm_deadline_at is null or confirm_opens_at <= confirm_deadline_at

matches_one_live_per_court.name: matches_one_live_per_court
matches_one_live_per_court.where: status = 'live' and court_id is not null

matches_winner_is_a_participant.name: matches_winner_is_a_participant
matches_winner_is_a_participant.value: winner_team_id is null or winner_team_id = team_a_id or winner_team_id = team_b_id

payments_provider_uq.name: payments_provider_uq
payments_provider_uq.where: provider is not null and provider_payment_id is not null

refunds_provider_uq.name: refunds_provider_uq
refunds_provider_uq.where: provider is not null and provider_refund_id is not null

session_participants_seat_uq.name: session_participants_seat_uq
session_participants_seat_uq.where: seat_no is not null and state in ('joined'::participation_state, 'confirmed'::participation_state, 'checked_in'::participation_state, 'played'::participation_state, 'absent'::participation_state)

session_participants_guest_has_host.name: session_participants_guest_has_host
session_participants_guest_has_host.value: is_guest = false or invited_by_player_id is not null

session_participants_seat_shape.name: session_participants_seat_shape
session_participants_seat_shape.value:
(state in ('waitlisted'::participation_state, 'withdrawn'::participation_state) and seat_no is null)
          or (state not in ('waitlisted'::participation_state, 'withdrawn'::participation_state) and seat_no is not null)

session_participants_override_shape.name: session_participants_override_shape
session_participants_override_shape.value: (price_override_paise is null and price_note is null) or (price_override_paise is not null and price_note is not null)

tournaments_court_hours.name: tournaments_court_hours
tournaments_court_hours.value: (court_from_min is null) = (court_until_min is null) and (court_from_min is null or (court_from_min >= 0 and court_until_min > court_from_min and court_until_min <= 1440))
